messages:
Maria Gomez: heads up — we just got a billing ticket where a customer saw duplicate token charges for a single streaming request. details in ticket #3421.
Ashok Patel: can you paste the raw request/response? curious if client retried with the same session id or a new one.
Maria Gomez: from logs: client opened an HTTP/2 stream, got an EOF after 3 chunks, then retried the same call on a new connection. server accepted the retry and produced the rest; but billing shows tokens from both the partial and the retry.
Samir Chen: that's expected if we charge on chunk commit and the retry replays the starting prefix. are we deduping by client-provided id?
Maria Gomez: client didn't set idempotency-key. they used streaming without toolcall. looks like our provisional ledger accepted both segment credits.
Joel: ok — two angles: (1) console/ledgers need to present provisional vs confirmed credits clearly, (2) API should try to dedupe retries when possible.
Liz (console): +1 on UX. support saw charges attributed to different routes (hosted vs dedicated) which made it look like two separate requests in the dashboard.
Ashok Patel: why different routes? was retry routed to a different region/variant?
Maria Gomez: yes — original stream hit region A; retry routed to region B because the client's CDN rebalanced. both regions independently charged provisional tokens.
Samir Chen: that's the core problem: provisional credits are local to a route. without a global session tag we can't merge provisional credits on reconcile.
Joel: proposal: require SDKs and recommend header X-Session-Id for streaming sessions. server will use it to correlate provisional credits across routes and only mark confirmed once final ack arrives.
Ashok Patel: we already have session_id in private deployments for stateful handoffs, but public API doesn't enforce it. forcing it could break some clients. can we do transparent correlation?
Samir Chen: we could generate a server-side correlation id if client doesn't send one — but client retries across regions won't include it. only client-supplied id survives reconnects.
Maria Gomez: support suggests a short-term console fix: show provisional credits per-route and add a reconciliation flag on account ledger rows so ops can see potential duplicates. low lift.
Liz (console): I can add a tooltip + new column: "provisional_origin: routeID" and add a reconciliation helper that groups by session id when present.
Joel: long-term: add a dedupe step in billing pipeline that collapses provisional credits within a 60s window if they share (1) client session id OR (2) identical prompt hash + initial offset. we need to be careful not to undercharge.
Samir Chen: I worry about "identical prompt hash" collisions for short prompts. maybe require both prompt hash and first-k-token sequence match and same customer id. also only collapse if one of the entries is provisional and the other confirmed.
Ashok Patel: what about toolcalls? toolcall semantics are worse: if a toolcall triggers external action we cannot safely dedupe without idempotency support from the tool. billing dedupe should not affect toolcall side effects.
Maria Gomez: ticket said no toolcall, but worth noting.
Joel: action items: Maria — add ticket note and sample logs. Liz — quick console column for provisional_origin (ETA 2d). Samir & Ashok — draft billing dedupe RFC, include heuristics and safety checks (ETA EOW). I'll loop in legal/finance for approval.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: console column PR queued for review.
Liz (console): queued the mock in Figma: https://figma.redwood/example. will open PR after review.
Samir Chen: one more telem ask — add event stream: stream.segment.start and stream.segment.confirm with session_id and segment_id fields. that will make post-hoc reconciliation much easier.
Ashok Patel: agree. also add route_id to all provisional charge events. small change in router telemetry.
Maria Gomez: thanks. I'll reply to the customer with interim explanation + promise to add clearer provisioning in the console and escalate billing reconcile if needed.
Joel: thanks team. keeping this open until RFC lands and console change is merged.
Maria Gomez: noted — reassigning ticket to eng-platform.
